summary: On MI355X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015, eager decode had 79 kernels overlapping each of nine CPU decode markers, while graph-on had nine hipGraphLaunch calls and no kernels overlapping any decode marker. Unlike the issue's older image, internal graph kernels were opaque rather than emitted as a deferred burst. Runtime warnings identify the torch.profiler GPU activity backend as ROCTracer. The separate rocprofv3 1.1.0 rocprofiler-sdk tool exposed per-replay dispatches when explicit NVTX/ROCTx markers were present, but SGLang step markers are Kineto record_function spans and the tool requires launch/attach injection, so no evidence-supported /start_profile correction was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Real eager SGLang HTTP generation and torch.profiler trace: nine decode markers, 900 total kernels, 79 kernels overlapping every decode marker.
Real graph-on SGLang HTTP generation and torch.profiler trace: nine decode markers, nine hipGraphLaunch calls, zero kernels overlapping all nine decode markers.
Parsed marker/kernel timestamp overlap from both retained Chrome traces.
rocprofiler-sdk recorded four GPU dispatches inside each of ten explicit replay markers; ten GPU sums exactly matched the independent CPU result (max absolute error 0.0).

gpu_execution_evidence: Assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 executed eager and graph-on SGLang generation plus the rocprofiler-sdk graph probe; raw traces, responses, logs, and numerical comparison are retained under reports/j-60f61744b18d/evidence.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights and four GPUs were unavailable; TP4, DP attention, MoE overlap, and the exact reported workload remain unverified.
The qualified tiny random Llama validates only transport, engine execution, graph replay, and tracing mechanics, not DeepSeek architecture or semantics.
This newer stack makes graph replay kernels opaque in torch.profiler instead of emitting the reported post-marker burst.
rocprofv3 needs explicit ROCTx/NVTX step markers and process launch/attach integration; SGLang currently emits decode steps only as Kineto record_function spans.
